BCK business in Kenya. With the enactment, the bank needs to:

• Law of Contract Act (Cap. 23), contracts to reflect the amendments on execution.
• Industrial Training Act (Cap. 237),
• review and adjust the submission timelines for training levies
• Stamp Duty Act (Cap. 480),
as required and amend policies where necessary to reflect the

amendments.

• NSSF Act • review and adjust the submission timelines for remittances to NHIF
• Companies Act (Cap 486), and NSSF as required
• Insolvency Act (No. 18 of 2015)) and • amend policies to cater for requirement to hold
• Small Claims Court Act virtual meetings.
